descriptionChirho: A gentilic designation identifying Jesus as originating from Nazareth in Galilee, used as a title or identifier ('Jesus the Nazarene'). The two clusters differ only in case: S72637 covers nominative, genitive, and accusative singular, while S72638 covers vocative and genitive singular. All translations render identically: Spanish 'Nazareno', Hindi नासरी, Arabic الناصري, Korean 나사렛 사람, Swahili 'Mnazareti/wa Nazareti'. The vocative usage (Mark 1:24 'Nazarene!') is an address form, not a different meaning. BDAG lists one entry. Purely inflectional variation of a single gentilic noun.
